routes.name: POST /api/agent/tick
routes.summary: POST /api/agent/tick: validates TickRequest, proxies to AGENT_BACKEND_URL/tick or streams the mock agent as NDJSON.

routes.name: POST /api/action
routes.summary: POST /api/action: approve a pending purchase; proxies to AGENT_BACKEND_URL/action or runs runMockAction.

routes.name: POST /api/chat
routes.summary: POST /api/chat: chat message plus dashboard context; proxies to backend /chat or runMockChat (returns reply + actions like add_mission).

modules.name: useAutopilot
modules.summary: Client autopilot loop: every checkIntervalSeconds POSTs /api/agent/tick, applies NDJSON events, approve/decline via /api/action, addMission.

modules.name: useChat
modules.summary: Chat state; posts /api/chat and applies returned actions to autopilot.

modules.name: useMedia
modules.summary: Media-query hooks.

modules.name: AgentEvent
modules.summary: Wire types: AgentEvent union, TickRequest, Mission, Guardrails, Approval, Receipt, Chat*, DashboardState, AutopilotApi.

modules.name: Run
modules.summary: K-trail v0 contract (owner cc): Run, Step, Claim, Decision, Action, Trust, Verdict; fsa panel field for D1.

modules.name: applyEvent
modules.summary: Pure reducer applying AgentEvents to DashboardState.

modules.name: runMockTick
modules.summary: Deterministic mock agent: runMockTick generator (search, compare, auto-buy or approval, builds a K-trail Run) and runMockAction. Triggers: "fail", "decline".

modules.name: runMockChat
modules.summary: Mock chat intents (watch X under $Y → add_mission).

modules.name: readNdjson
modules.summary: Streams NDJSON response lines into AgentEvent callback.

modules.name: formatPrice
modules.summary: formatPrice / formatTime helpers.

modules.name: RootLayout
modules.summary: Root layout: fonts, metadata from appConfig.

modules.name: Page
modules.summary: Home page; renders Dashboard.

modules.name: Dashboard
modules.summary: Main screen: header, stat tiles, missions, runs, audit trail, approvals, receipts, docked chat; compact view under 720px.

modules.name: AppHeader
modules.summary: Header with app name and the Autopilot switch, countdown and Check now.

modules.name: ApprovalsPanel
modules.summary: Approval inbox for purchases above the auto-buy limit; approve/decline.

modules.name: AuditTrail
modules.summary: Activity/audit trail of AuditSteps with JSON export.

modules.name: ChatPanel
modules.summary: Chat UI with inline approval cards.

modules.name: CompactView
modules.summary: Mobile/compact Electron layout.

modules.name: MissionsPanel
modules.summary: Watched missions (wishlist-like) list plus add form.

modules.name: ReceiptsPanel
modules.summary: Receipts for completed purchases.

modules.name: RunView
modules.summary: K-trail Run renderer: timeline, claims with trust/verdict, decision card, receipt, injection banner.

modules.name: RunsPanel
modules.summary: List of K-trail Runs opening RunView.

modules.name: StatTiles
modules.summary: KPI tiles: spent today, auto-buys, approvals, missions.

tests.name: reduce.check.mjs
tests.summary: Assert-based self-check for reduce.ts (npm run check:agent).

tests.name: smoke.sh
tests.summary: HTTP smoke test of tick/action/chat routes and home page against a running server.

config.name: globals.css
config.summary: Tailwind v4 theme tokens (--primary etc.) for light/dark.

config.name: appConfig
config.summary: Re-skin point: name, tagline, guardrails (autoBuyLimit, dailyBudget), seed missions, sponsors, showDemoRuns.

config.name: AGENT_BACKEND_URL
config.summary: Optional backend base URL; empty = mock
